from pathlib import Path
import datetime, gzip, hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys, xml.etree.ElementTree as E

repo = Path('/workspace/The-Book-of-Eternity-Reborn')
record_path, archive_dir = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
c = json.loads(record_path.read_text())
ar = json.loads((archive_dir / 'archive.json').read_text())
h = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert c['kind'] == 'FIRST_PD3E_ORDINARY_BOUNDARY1_RAW_NOT_CAUSAL_ACCEPTANCE'
assert c['nativeExit'] == 1 and c['compiledSource'] == '7307e8f8c74c53bd836de7906d305c794766e1a1'
assert c['actualSource'] == c['headAfter'] and not c['statusAfter']
expected = {str(record_path), c['stdoutPath'], c['processRecord'], c['firstSentinel'], str(record_path.parent / 'source-binding.json')}
for directory in c['resultDirectories']:
    expected.update(str(p) for p in Path(directory).rglob('*') if p.is_file())
assert expected == {f['rawPath'] for f in ar['files']}
raws = {}
for f in ar['files']:
    b, z = Path(f['rawPath']).read_bytes(), (archive_dir / f['storedPath']).read_bytes()
    assert len(b) == f['bytes'] and h(b) == f['sha256']
    assert len(z) == f['storedBytes'] and h(z) == f['storedSha256'] and gzip.decompress(z) == b
    name = Path(f['rawPath']).name
    assert name not in raws
    raws[name] = b
assert json.loads(raws['record.json']) == c and h(raws['stdout.log']) == c['stdoutSha256']
assert len(c['binaryBefore']) == 9 and c['binaryBefore'] == c['binaryAfter']
for f in c['binaryAfter']:
    b = (repo / f['path']).read_bytes()
    assert len(b) == f['bytes'] and h(b) == f['sha256']
assert c['namespaceBefore'] == c['namespaceAfter'] == {'ownedRoots': []}
binding = json.loads(raws['source-binding.json'])
assert len(binding['sourcePins']) == 54 and binding['productDelta'] == []
assert h(json.dumps(binding['sourcePins'], ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode()) == binding['sourcePinDigest']
for f in binding['sourcePins']:
    b = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', c['actualSource'] + ':' + f['path']], cwd=repo)
    assert len(b) == f['bytes'] and h(b) == f['sha256']
diff = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', c['compiledSource'], c['actualSource']], cwd=repo, text=True).splitlines()
assert all(p.startswith('specs/1536-complete-wound-materialization/') for p in diff)
s = json.loads(raws['summary.json'])
assert s['Tests'] == dict(Total=1, Executed=1, Passed=0, Failed=1)
selection = s['Selection']
assert selection['Complete'] and selection['PlannedCases'] == selection['CompletedCases'] == 1
assert selection['PlannedDescriptors'] == selection['CompletedDescriptors'] == 1 and not selection['UnderfilledDescriptors']
assert s['OwnedTreeCleanupSucceeded'] and s['RuntimeCleanupSucceeded'] and not s['TimedOut'] and not s['DuplicateTests']
trxs = [b for n, b in raws.items() if n.endswith('.trx')]
assert len(trxs) == 1
x = E.fromstring(trxs[0]); ns = {'t': x.tag.split('}')[0].lstrip('{')}
rows = x.findall('.//t:UnitTestResult', ns); assert len(rows) == 1
row = rows[0]; assert row.attrib['outcome'] == 'Failed'
definition = x.find('.//t:UnitTest[@id="' + row.attrib['testId'] + '"]/t:TestMethod', ns)
assert definition is not None
fqn = definition.attrib['className'].split(',')[0] + '.' + definition.attrib['name']
assert fqn == 'BookOfEternityClient.Tests.AcceptedTurnReasoningPolicyBoundaryTests.PublicFullOwner_ConsumesSharedDocumentAndScopePrefix'
message = row.findtext('t:Output/t:ErrorInfo/t:Message', '', ns)
stack = row.findtext('t:Output/t:ErrorInfo/t:StackTrace', '', ns)
stdout = row.findtext('t:Output/t:StdOut', '', ns)
assert 'Assert.NotNull() Failure: Value is null' in message
assert 'AcceptedTurnReasoningPolicyBoundaryTests.cs:line 29' in stack
assert 'REAL_PUBLIC_FULL_PREFIX_PREREQUISITES_COMPLETE' in stdout
receipts = []
for line in stdout.splitlines():
    try: value = json.loads(line)
    except json.JSONDecodeError: continue
    if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get('kind') == 'PD3E_REASONING_STRICT_CLEANUP': receipts.append(value)
assert len(receipts) == 1
root = receipts[0]['root']
assert receipts[0]['removed'] and root.startswith('/tmp/boe-pd3e-reasoning-') and not os.path.lexists(root)
out = dict(kind='ROOT_FIRST_PD3E_BOUNDARY1_LITERAL_CAUSAL_INSPECTION_NOT_INDEPENDENT_VERDICT', actualSource=c['actualSource'],
           compiledSource=c['compiledSource'], nativeExit=1, wallSeconds=c['wallSeconds'], summary=s,
           rawChains=len(ar['files']), archiveSha256=h((archive_dir / 'archive.json').read_bytes()), fqn=fqn,

           helperSource=Path(__file__).read_text(), utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
dest = Path('/tmp/t179pd3e-root-first-boundary1-inspection-' + c['actualSource'][:8] + '-20261017.json')
assert not dest.exists(); dest.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2) + '\n')
